issues.title: SSO support is included while browser password login remains active
issues.problem: The report did not clearly separate including SSO support in the PR from enabling it. The pending login page could briefly assume SSO was on. The earlier restore also changed local-only login/sign-out navigation.
issues.fix: Keep local authentication enabled and provider settings unset. Gate automatic SSO entry and the special SSO sign-out destination on configured SSO with local authentication disabled; default the pending SSO button to hidden. Fresh normal admin and demo password sign-ins succeeded, incorrect credentials were rejected, and local account creation/reset/password controls remained available. No current authentication rollout setting was changed.
issues.status: Fresh manual localhost observations on 128181050; password login enabled, SSO disabled

issues.title: One Microsoft sign-in flow for users and administrators
issues.problem: Earlier localhost evidence used local password accounts and did not demonstrate the requested SSO journey. The login link assumed a fixed provider and SSO errors did not offer a useful browser retry.
issues.fix: Use the configured provider and preserve the return destination. Automatic sign-in and the neutral sign-out screen apply only when SSO is configured and password login is disabled. Current password-only login and sign-out keep their existing flow. The pending login page no longer assumes SSO is enabled before its signals arrive.
issues.status: Included for future configuration; inactive now. Earlier simulated-provider evidence, not a live Microsoft login.

issues.title: SSO-only administration still offered local password accounts
issues.problem: Even with local authentication disabled, the Users page offered Create local user and a password-account dialog. Backend creation and reset routes did not consistently respect that mode.
issues.fix: Hide and reject local-user creation/reset only when password authentication is disabled. With password login enabled, administrators retain those controls and local users retain Change password. Externally managed identities still cannot change a local password. Today’s password-mode screenshots above demonstrate the current behavior.
issues.status: Included for future configuration; inactive now. Earlier simulated-provider evidence, not a live Microsoft login.

issues.title: Explicit administrator onboarding and project delegation
issues.problem: A Microsoft identity is separate from a local administrator even when their email matches. Platform administration alone also does not confer project delegation or data access.
issues.fix: An optional offline installation-operator command can nominate a verified existing OIDC principal by UUID, with preview, exclusive lock and audited apply. It has no effect unless explicitly invoked. No nomination was run in this update; project grants and current passwords remain separate.
issues.status: Included for future configuration; inactive now. Earlier simulated-provider evidence, not a live Microsoft login.

issues.title: Chat offered dashboard creation without a grant
issues.problem: An Explorer was shown Build a dashboard even though the existing dashboard-create route denied that account. Preview/Add controls could also assume an existing builder was editable before it answered.
issues.fix: Use the same request-bound project creation permission for chat starters, preview controls and agent authoring tools. Existing dashboard edits wait for an explicit canEdit response from the exact builder frame; failed or cross-origin loads keep editing disabled and show a readable message.
issues.status: Fixed; grant, permitted creation and revocation demonstrated locally

issues.title: Agent authorization and protected metric metadata
issues.problem: Builder turn context could advertise editing for a read-only draft. Legacy restricted credentials with empty permission metadata could enter authoring preparation. Protected semantic members were omitted even when their current consumer could see them.
issues.fix: Require actual builder edit capability and reject every restricted authoring credential. Resolve protected semantic metadata through the exact principal/model/generation consumer. Expose only permitted member names, labels, types, aggregation and units; redact physical bindings, raw input, expression and filters. Mark definitions as redacted so the model does not infer hidden formulas.
issues.status: Source fixes built; local deterministic chat transport observed; production reasoning and restrictive-policy matrix unverified

issues.title: User permissions stay under administrator control
issues.problem: The requested experience needs a clear distinction between signing in, reading/exploring, creating dashboards and administering access.
issues.fix: The local audit administrator grants and removes project roles through the ordinary UI. Explorer can browse governed datasets but cannot create a dashboard. Editor enables dashboard creation while admin pages and self-grants remain denied. Removing Editor removes builder access again.
issues.status: Manual local permission flow; no user self-grant
